messages:
rory: heads-up — APAC GPU swarm nodes are failing keystore handshake during join, lots of retries in the last 10m :warning:
anita: saw autoscaler spin up a bunch of retries around 02:14 SGT, looks like KMS decrypt returns AccessDenied
sre-anna: agent logs: KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied + sts:AssumeRole 403 from keystore endpoint. stack snippets show endpoint policy rejecting our warmpool principal because it lacks the new principal-tag condition
devin: which change caused that? i missed the deploy this morning
security-liz: I pushed a tighter endpoint policy to the keystore privatelink to restrict cross-account principals (added condition principal:tag/team==infra). aim was to reduce noisy creds, rollout at 01:50 SGT via infra-cfg pipeline
rory: timeline matches. APAC warmpool roles are created by older onboarding flow and don't have that tag, so endpoint denies decrypt and node aborts join
anita: impact: ~200 failed joins in 12m, autoscaler queued ~80 extra launches and fell back to on-demand for critical pools. no customer requests hit errors yet but our capacity margin evaporated
sre-anna: quick impact calc: 80 extra on-demand * avg 1.5h * $2/hr ~= $240. plus spot churn and extra scheduling pressure. if this runs longer cost climbs fast
devin: remediation proposal: 1) add short-lived allowlist for warmpool role ARN(s) in endpoint policy (20m) 2) kick role-tag backfill job for APAC onboarding 3) revert conditional in infra-cfg if backfill lags 4) add pre-deploy validation for principal tags
security-liz: can do allowlist now. will make it expire in 25m. also filing RFC to require tag in onboarding and add deploy hold step for keystore policy changes
ops-bot: ticket INF-4620 created: "keystore endpoint policy blocks apac warmpool roles; temp allowlist". PR: https://git.internal/infra/endpoint-pol/ps/134 (draft)
anita: after allowlist we should monitor node-join-rate and KMS:Decrypt error-rate. set alert threshold to 5m spike > 10x baseline
sre-anna: pushing backfill job (onboarding-service/job/309) now to add tag to historical warmpool roles in ap-southeast-1
security-liz: allowlist deployed at 02:28 SGT. kept window short and logged principals added
ops-bot: policy amendment applied by security-liz at 02:28 SGT, rollback scheduled at 02:53 SGT unless extended
rory: node-joins recovering, warmpool healthy at 02:33 SGT. thanks
devin: follow-ups: add canary checklist for endpoint policy changes, add an integration test that simulates role without tag, and document short-lived allowlist playbook in runbook/keystore.md
anita: created runbook section and alert run (pager on KMS decrypt spike)
sre-anna: i'll extract join-failure counts and the cost delta for postmortem-lite. will post metrics and a graph in #postmortems later
security-liz: filing RFC for deploy gating + small human approval for keystore/privatelink policies. will propose automated role-tag remediation pipeline too
rory: good catch, team. closing thread once postmortem link is posted. :thumbsup:
